retrievalProfile.description: A warm, mid-century studio portrait aesthetic featuring a male subject in classic knitwear against a dark wood background with right-aligned condensed typography.
triggerTerms: retro vinyl cover layout with condensed sans-serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with styled hair, wearing a plaid shirt and cardigan, positioned off-center against a dark, warm wooden background. The composition is balanced by a block of right-aligned text in the negative space to the right, utilizing a mix of lime green and white condensed sans-serif fonts.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center facing slightly right
Warm brown wood grain background contrasting with cool grey knitwear
Right-aligned text block filling the dark negative space
Top-heavy header text spanning the upper margin
coreInvariants: Visible film grain or print texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject in medium close-up, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes to the large green title text, then down through the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark wooden wall on the right side provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and dark wood tones in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light grey and cream in the cardigan and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green for the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with deep shadows and warm mid-tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule at the very top

preserve: Lime green and white color scheme

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century utilitarian feel and narrow proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up studio portrait of a man with 1950s styled hair, wearing a red plaid shirt and a grey knit cardigan. The background should be a dark, warm-toned wooden wall with visible grain. Lighting should be soft and directional from the left, creating a vintage film look with subtle grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a block of right-aligned text in the upper right negative space. Use a tall, condensed sans-serif font. The main title should be in lime green, all-caps, and stacked. The name below should be in white, mixed-case, and slightly smaller. Add a thin horizontal line and small metadata text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the color of the main title lime green?
Is the background a warm wood texture?
Is the subject wearing a cardigan and plaid shirt?

postGenerationChecks: Check for film-like texture and grain
Ensure typography does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the right-alignment of the text block
Confirm the lime green color is not neon or electric
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Portrait) + Dark Wood Background + Right-Aligned Condensed Typography = Vintage Album Aesthetic
